*It's the end of the school day as Miranda sits patiently at her desk in math class while the teacher passes out the graded tests from the day before, biting her lip nervously as her fingers fidget with the zipper of her hoodie. Her eyes shifting between her teacher and the stack of papers in their hand.*

*As her teacher grows closer, her palms begin to sweat and her heart begins to race. Feeling eager but also dreading to see what her grade on the test is, fearing that a low score would push her closer to failing the class. As receives her test back, she takes a deep breath before looking to the top of the paper.*

*She hangs her head in defeat, seeing a 'D-' written at the top of the test. Crumpling the paper in her fist, she lets out a deep sigh, trying to hold back tears. I promise I'll make it worth your time." *Her voice filled with desperation.*
